title: Day 8 Intelligence
subtitle: Friends, relatives, surveillance evidence, and expert-disclosure litigation
one_liner: Personal witnesses described Lindsay and the family, a State Police witness addressed ThreeV surveillance, and the court heard disputes over defense experts.
purpose: Separate lay observations, business-surveillance timing, and counsel's expert-disclosure arguments into their correct evidentiary and procedural lanes.
what_changed: The record gained observations from Amy Bevins, Christopher Clancy, and Kyle Carney, plus Andrew Chiachio's investigative testimony and a substantial procedural dispute about proposed defense experts.
